# Tackle Accessibility — WCAG 2.2 AA

Every component, page, and custom UI MUST meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Apply the W3C ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) pattern for each widget type.

The Tackle design system components handle their own internal a11y (focus traps, semantics, ARIA primitives via `@base-ui/react`). This skill covers everything _around_ and _between_ those components: form composition, focus order across views, page landmarks, custom widgets, and any UI you build yourself.

## Semantic HTML First

- Use native HTML elements before ARIA: `<button>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, `<dialog>`, `<fieldset>`, `<legend>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<header>`, `<table>`.
- Never put `role="button"` on a `<div>` when `<button>` works.
- Every `<input>` must have a programmatically associated `<label>` (explicit `for`/`id` or wrapping). Use `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` only when a visible label is impossible.

## Keyboard Interaction

- All interactive elements must be operable with keyboard alone (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys, Escape).
- Follow APG keyboard patterns per widget type:
  - **Tabs**: Arrow keys move between tabs; Tab moves into the panel.
  - **Menu / MenuBar**: Arrow keys navigate; Enter/Space activate; Escape closes.
  - **Dialog / Modal**: Tab traps focus inside; Escape closes; focus returns to trigger on close.
  - **ComboBox**: Arrow keys navigate options; Enter selects; Escape closes listbox.
  - **Radio Group**: Arrow keys move selection within `role="radiogroup"`.
  - **Tree View**: Arrow keys expand/collapse/navigate.
- `tabindex="0"` for focusable custom widgets; `tabindex="-1"` for programmatically focused elements. Never use `tabindex` > 0.

## Focus Management

- **Focus visible (2.4.7 + 2.4.13)**: Every focusable element must have a visible focus indicator with at least 2px outline and 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors. Use `:focus-visible` (not `:focus`) to avoid showing outlines on mouse click.
- **Focus not obscured (2.4.11)**: Focused elements must not be fully hidden by sticky headers, drawers, or overlays.
- **Focus order (2.4.3)**: DOM order must match visual order. Never use CSS to reorder elements in a way that breaks tab sequence.
- **Modal focus trap**: On open, move focus to the first focusable element (or the dialog itself). On close, return focus to the trigger element. Cycle Tab between first and last focusable items inside.
- Use `useRef` + `useEffect` for programmatic focus. Generate unique IDs with `useId()`.

## Color & Contrast

- **Text contrast (1.4.3)**: Normal text ≥ 4.5:1; large text (≥ 24px or ≥ 18.66px bold) ≥ 3:1.
- **Non-text contrast (1.4.11)**: UI components and graphical objects ≥ 3:1 against adjacent colors. This includes: borders, icons, focus rings, chart elements, form control boundaries.
- **Never use color alone (1.4.1)**: Pair color with text, icons, or patterns. Error states need an icon or text label, not just red.
- Validate every design token pairing. If a token doesn't meet contrast on its intended background, flag it.

## ARIA Attributes — Required per Component Type

| Component       | Required ARIA                                                                                              |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Button          | Native `<button>` or `role="button"` + `aria-pressed`/`aria-expanded` where applicable                     |
| Checkbox        | `<input type="checkbox">` + `aria-checked` (or `indeterminate`); group: `role="group"` + `aria-labelledby` |
| Radio           | `<input type="radio">` inside `<fieldset>` with `<legend>`; or `role="radiogroup"` + `aria-labelledby`     |
| Switch          | `role="switch"` + `aria-checked`                                                                           |
| ComboBox        | `role="combobox"` + `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` + `aria-activedescendant`                            |
| Dropdown/Select | `role="listbox"` + `aria-labelledby`; options: `role="option"` + `aria-selected`                           |
| Menu            | `role="menu"` + `aria-labelledby`; items: `role="menuitem"`                                                |
| Tabs            | `role="tablist"`, `role="tab"` + `aria-selected` + `aria-controls`, `role="tabpanel"` + `aria-labelledby`  |
| Dialog/Modal    | `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby` + `aria-describedby`                             |
| Alert           | `role="alert"` (implicit `aria-live="assertive"`)                                                          |
| Tooltip         | `role="tooltip"` + `aria-describedby` on trigger                                                           |
| Navigation      | `<nav>` + `aria-label` (distinguish multiple navs)                                                         |
| Banner          | `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` for non-critical messages                                          |

## Live Regions & Dynamic Content

- Urgent messages (`Alert`): `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"`.
- Status updates (`Banner`, toast, progress): `aria-live="polite"` + `aria-atomic="true"`.
- Never inject new content into a live region at page load — wait for user action.
- Form validation errors: associate with the field via `aria-describedby` or `aria-errormessage`; announce on submission with a live region summary.

## Form Accessibility

- Every field needs: visible label, error message, helper text — all programmatically linked via `id`/`aria-describedby`/`aria-errormessage`.
- Required fields: `aria-required="true"` or HTML `required`; visual indicator (asterisk) + screen reader text.
- Disabled fields: `disabled` attribute (native) or `aria-disabled="true"`. Disabled elements should not be focusable.
- Group related controls with `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` or `role="group"`/`role="radiogroup"` + `aria-labelledby`.
- Error pattern: on submit, move focus to the first field with an error. Provide both inline errors and an error summary.

## Page Structure & Landmarks

- Every page has exactly one `<main>` landmark.
- Use `<nav>` with `aria-label` to distinguish multiple navigation regions (primary nav, breadcrumbs, in-page nav).
- Heading hierarchy is sequential — `<h1>` once per page, then `<h2>`/`<h3>` in order. Never skip levels for visual styling.
- Skip-link target must be the `<main>` element or the first heading after the global nav.

## Icons & Images

- Decorative icons: `aria-hidden="true"` + `focusable="false"` on the `<svg>`.
- Meaningful icons (no adjacent text): `aria-label` on the button/link wrapping the icon, or `<title>` inside the SVG.
- Never use icon-only buttons without an accessible name.

## Motion & Animation

- **Reduced motion (2.3.3)**: Wrap animations in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` — disable or shorten to ≤ 0ms.
- No content that flashes more than 3 times per second.

## Testing Checklist (per component / page)

Before any component or view is considered complete:

1. Tab through every interactive state with keyboard only — verify logical order and visible focus.
2. Activate with Enter and Space where applicable.
3. Test with a screen reader (VoiceOver / NVDA) — verify name, role, state are announced correctly.
4. Run axe-core or Lighthouse — zero violations at AA level.
5. Check all text/icon contrast ratios with a contrast checker.
6. Verify at 200% browser zoom — no content is lost or overlapping.
7. Test with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — animations stop or shorten.
